name: Fortran
typeSystem: Static, with intrinsic and user-defined types. Declarations may be explicit, or implicitly inferred from a name unless IMPLICIT NONE disables implicit typing; numeric assignments can perform implicit conversions.

runtimes.name: Native (gfortran / ifx / flang)
runtimes.role: AOT compiled; excels at numerical and high-performance computing.

concurrencyModel: The standard coarray/image model supports SPMD parallelism; OpenMP directives and MPI are also common external approaches.

codeExample.source:
program hello
  implicit none
  integer :: i
  do i = 1, 10
    print *, 'Iteration', i
  end do
end program hello
